scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Secret key of a [Turnstile widget](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile) whose hostnames include the sites that show comments.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Any long random string (for example `openssl rand -hex 32`). You enter it on `/admin` to moderate.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Sites that embed the comments, comma separated, for example `https://blog.example.com,https://example.com`.

WEBHOOK_CONTENT.description: `true` puts the name and body into `WEBHOOK_URL` notifications. Add the `WEBHOOK_URL` secret later in Settings to get them.
